title: e2e_send_message_clears_input_on_success test simulates run() logic manually rather than calling it
description: The test e2e_send_message_clears_input_on_success (event.rs line 2062) calls send_message(), then manually replicates the state.input.clear() / state.input_cursor = 0 logic from run(), then asserts the state is cleared. This means the test does not actually test the run() code path — it tests send_message() success and then self-certifies the manual clear. If the real run() code at lines 964-966 were changed to not clear the cursor, this test would still pass. This is a test oracle weakness: the test should call the actual run() or a helper that contains the input-clear logic, not reimplement it.
